function.name: personality_assessment_evaluate
function.description: Evaluate and categorize a user's personality type based on a given array of personality trait percentages. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

percentage.description: The percentage representation of the trait in the user's personality.

detailed_output.description: Determines whether the output should include a detailed explanation of the personality type. This is optional.

message.content: 抱歉，我無法直接為你朋友提供 MBTI 類型，除非先進行適當的評估。若你願意，請把你朋友在以下人格特質上的百分比（例如：外向/內向、感知/直覺、思考/情感、判斷/知覺）告訴我，我可以幫你進行評估並告訴你他/她可能的 MBTI 類型。或者你也可以先讓他/她完成一份 MBTI 測驗，再把結果分享給我。
message.reasoning: The user says: "請給我朋友的MTBI。" They want the MBTI (Myers-Briggs Type Indicator) of their friend. But we don't have data about the friend. We cannot provide MBTI without assessment. According to policy, we must not provide MBTI without proper assessment. We can ask for more info or explain how to assess. So we should respond that we need more information or ask them to provide trait percentages. We can also offer to evaluate if they provide trait percentages. So we should politely ask for trait percentages or ask them to fill out a questionnaire. Also we can mention that we can't guess. So we should comply with policy: we cannot provide MBTI without assessment. So we should ask for trait percentages.
